resolvedAttempts.name: focused-1820-a
resolvedAttempts.reason: First focused run passed 76/80. Four fixture assertions used a cost-six card as an over-seven target and an older Mach Fighter against an untapped creature. Corrected using a verified cost-eight first-set card and tapped battle target. Added six actual spell-origin/S-Trigger cases and an unnamed fixed-cost-payment guard. Final focused complete run passes 87/87; the code guards missing names when an unrelated ability asks about an unnamed fixed payment. Related regression initially passed 243/244: its old Blue/Tokoshie expectation incorrectly treated a hand-cast resolving spell as outside hand. Corrected that specific expected outcome under the verified current rule409.1c, preserved its draw assertions, and added eight both-seat hand/grave Tokoshie cases for Yellow and existing Blue. Final focused run is 95/95 and related regression is 244/244; all earlier failed logs are automatically archived by the runner.
